in_marathi.name: Eshvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshvika is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Goddess of Prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Eshvika is considered an incarnation of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and abundance to those who invoke her.
